_meta.description: Quest dialogue for MQ-25: The Grand Expedition. Year 3 Spring/Summer — Spire Wastes expedition, final lore.

lines.speaker: npc_harrow
lines.text: The Marshal retreated, but he's not beaten. Intelligence from our allies confirms he's regrouping in the Scorchlands. Building new machines. Recruiting.

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: We can't wait for him to come back stronger. The Council agrees — it's time to take the fight to him. But first, we need to understand what he's truly after.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: The Grand Spire. Every data core I've recovered points to it — the central hub of the AEGIS network. If the Marshal gains control of that terminal, he could reactivate the entire military AI grid.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: And Jack... that terminal also holds the truth about what happened during The Sundering. What I did. What I chose. I need to know.

lines.speaker: npc_linden
lines.text: The Spire Wastes are the most dangerous region on the map. Nobody's gone that deep and come back. You'll need a full expedition — supplies, combat support, the works.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Then we prepare properly and we go. Both of us, DEJIN. Together.

lines.speaker: npc_spark
lines.text: I've triple-checked your mech. Loaded extra ammo, fuel cells, repair kits. And I added a little something — a secondary power coupling. Just in case.

lines.speaker: npc_harrow
lines.text: A squad of our best guard bots will accompany you. Leera's volunteered to lead the ground team. I'll hold Coppervale in your absence.

lines.speaker: npc_maren
lines.text: Come back to us, Jack. This town needs its engineer. And its heart.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: The Spire Wastes. What remains of Solara — the Old World capital. Population before The Sundering: 4.2 million. Current population: zero.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: The Grand Spire is visible from here — that structure on the horizon. It was the central command tower for the entire AEGIS defense network. My... birthplace, in a sense.

lines.speaker: npc_leera
lines.text: Look at this place. Everything's fused — metal, stone, glass, all melted together. Whatever happened here wasn't a battle. It was an extinction event.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Data core recovered. Processing... These are the final command logs before shutdown. The military leadership ordered a full retaliatory strike. Every AEGIS node received the order simultaneously.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Node Seven refused and shut down. Nodes Three and Twelve complied — they launched. The destruction you see outside... that was us. That was the network I was part of.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: What about you? What did Node One do?

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: I... the records are fragmented here. The answer is in the Apex terminal. I need to go higher.

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: [Via radio] Jack, the Scorchland offensive is underway. Allied forces have hit three of the Marshal's supply depots. His logistics are in chaos.

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: But he knows you're at the Spire. He's redirecting forces your way. You need to reach the Apex before he does.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [In the Marshal's private quarters — a spartan room with maps covering every wall. Among the military documents, personal items: a child's drawing, a photograph of a woman, a worn letter.]

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Jack, look at this. The Marshal's real name is Dorian Voss. He was a military logistics officer before The Sundering. His wife and daughter were in Solara when...

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: He lost everything that day. Everything. And he's spent two decades trying to make sure it never happens again — by controlling the very systems that caused it.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: He's not evil. He's broken.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Broken people can still be dangerous, Jack. Perhaps more so than cruel ones. They believe they're right.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: The Apex is above us. One more climb. And then... the truth. Whatever it is, I'm ready. Because of you, Jack. Because you showed me that what matters isn't what you were built for — it's what you choose to become.
